methodology.citationRule: one unique exact quotation on the cited source page
methodology.reviewerMethod: A human subject-matter reviewer must independently compare every draft case with the official source package, add objectively missing critical obligations, and sign off before scoring.

limitations: This draft is benchmark preparation, not an application input.
It is not a completeness, precision, or recall claim.
The source package references external signatory and standard-terms documents that are not part of this one-document draft.
No benchmark case is independently accepted until a qualified human reviewer records review.

cases.title: Electronic questions are due February 15, 2008 at 5:00 PM
cases.exactQuote: Bidder’s Electronic Question Due Date (Refer to RFP Section 1.3.1 for more information.) February 15, 2008 5:00 PM

cases.title: Bid submission is due March 7, 2008 at 2:00 PM
cases.exactQuote: Bid Submission Due Date (Refer to RFP Section 1.3.2 for more information.) March 7, 2008 2:00 PM

cases.title: Late bids at the stated location are rejected
cases.exactQuote: ANY BID PROPOSAL NOT RECEIVED ON TIME AT THE LOCATION INDICATED BELOW WILL BE REJECTED.

cases.title: Deliver the proposal to the Purchase Bureau bid receiving room
cases.exactQuote: BID RECEIVING ROOM - 9TH FLOOR PURCHASE BUREAU DIVISION OF PURCHASE AND PROPERTY DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY 33 WEST STATE STREET, P.O. BOX 230 TRENTON, NJ 08625-0230

cases.title: Bidders are responsible for monitoring issued addenda
cases.exactQuote: It is the sole responsibility of the bidder to be knowledgeable of all addenda related to this procurement.
cases.reviewNote: Addenda are part of the solicitation and must be monitored.

cases.title: Label the exterior package with the bid ID and final opening date
cases.exactQuote: THE EXTERIOR OF ALL BID PROPOSAL PACKAGES ARE TO BE LABELED WITH THE BID IDENTIFICATION NUMBER AND THE FINAL BID OPENING DATE OR RISK NOT BEING RECEIVED IN TIME.

cases.title: Submit one original, four full copies, and one unbound copy
cases.exactQuote: The bidder must submit one (1) complete ORIGINAL bid proposal , clearly marked as the “ORIGINAL” bid proposal. The bidder should submit four (4) full, complete and exact copies and one (1) unbound, complete and exact copy of the original.
cases.reviewNote: Required and requested copy-count instructions remain separately visible.

cases.title: Submit a signatory page signed by an authorized representative
cases.exactQuote: The Signatory page shall be signed by an authorized representative of the bidder.

cases.title: Failure to comply with signatory instructions causes rejection
cases.exactQuote: Failure to comply will result in rejection of the bid proposal.
cases.reviewNote: Explicit consequence immediately following signatory rules.

cases.title: Complete the Ownership Disclosure Form
cases.exactQuote: the bidder must complete the attached Ownership Disclosure Form.

cases.title: Use the Disclosure of Investigations and Actions form
cases.exactQuote: The bidder shall use the Disclosure of Investigations and Actions Involving Bidder form

cases.title: Every bidder completes the Notice of Intent to Subcontract Form
cases.exactQuote: All bidders shall complete the attached Notice of Intent to Subcontract Form
cases.reviewNote: Required regardless of intended subcontractor use.

cases.title: Submit the Subcontractor Utilization Form when using a subcontractor
cases.exactQuote: If the bidder intends to utilize a subcontractor, the Subcontractor Utilization Form http://www.state.nj.us/treasury/purchase/bid/summary/08-x-39231.shtml must be completed and submitted with the bid proposal.
cases.reviewNote: Conditional named form; condition must remain attached.

cases.title: Include the Business Registration Certificate or interim registration
cases.exactQuote: FAILURE TO SUBMIT A COPY OF THE BIDDER’S BUSINESS REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE (OR INTERIM REGISTRATION) FROM THE DIVISION OF REVENUE WITH THE BID PROPOSAL MAY BE CAUSE FOR REJECTION OF THE BID PROPOSAL.
cases.reviewNote: Named proof with an explicit rejection risk.

cases.title: Complete the MacBride Principles Certification
cases.exactQuote: The bidder is required to complete the attached MacBride Principles Certification evidencing compliance with the MacBride Principles.
cases.reviewNote: Pre-award form that should accompany the proposal.

cases.title: Submit affirmative-action evidence or complete Form AA-302
cases.exactQuote: If the bidder has neither document of Affirmative Action evidence, then the bidder must complete the attached Affirmative Action Employee Information Report (AA-302).

cases.title: Submit the completed Services Source Disclosure Form
cases.exactQuote: the bidder is required to submit with its bid proposal a completed source disclosure form.

cases.title: Describe the approach and plans for the scope of work
cases.exactQuote: the bidder shall describe its approach and plans for accomplishing the work outlined in the Scope of Work Section, i.e., Section 3.0.

cases.title: Provide employee information for personnel used under the contract
cases.exactQuote: The bidder shall provide below the information for its employees to be used under this contract.

cases.title: Provide proof of a valid New Jersey Detective Agency Permit
cases.exactQuote: New Jersey Detective Agency Permit Number (Proof of a valid permit must be provide with the bid proposal)

cases.title: Submit the certificate of insurance with the bid
cases.exactQuote: The certificate of insurance shall be submitted with the bid proposal

cases.title: Carry at least $5 million in professional liability insurance
cases.exactQuote: The insurance shall be in the amount of not less than $5,000,000 and in such policy forms as shall be approved by the State.
cases.reviewNote: Material insurance threshold; company proof remains a separate axis.

cases.title: Use the State-supplied price sheets and provide all requested pricing
cases.exactQuote: The bidder must submit its pricing using the format set forth in the State supplied price sheet(s) attached to this RFP. Failure to submit all information required will result in the bid being considered non-responsive.
cases.reviewNote: Pricing format and explicit nonresponsiveness consequence.

cases.title: Provide the required performance bond after award
cases.exactQuote: A performance bond is required.
cases.reviewNote: Bond amount is referenced to the signatory page; the source package needs reviewer confirmation of that amount.

cases.title: Incorporate Addendum 1 changes into the original RFP
cases.exactQuote: It is the bidder’s responsibility to ensure that all changes are incorporated into the original RFP.
